pos.personaBrief: Coaches' Voice says his teams try to dominate possession, and Gasperini says that if you wait you see the ball three times in 40 minutes. The high man-oriented press means he does not hand the ball over to counter.

pro.personaBrief: Atalanta build short from the keeper to Palomino with a back-three overload (Coaches' Voice), but the transitions are quick and Roma 2025 uses long passes to forwards (TFA). Forward, vertical play with patient circulation at the start.

est.personaBrief: Defined 3-4-1-2 / 3-4-2-1 shape with wing-backs high and wide (Spielverlagerung), but with fluid man-marking across the pitch and a roaming Papu Gomez who drops into half-spaces. Structured but spread out, not tight rondo play.

lar.personaBrief: Wing-backs stay high and wide, wide centre-backs create double width, the central lane is the least used zone (Spielverlagerung) and he believes in chance creation from the wings (TFA).

blo.personaBrief: High aggressive press led by the forwards, immediate counter-press, Atalanta first in the league for balls recovered (AC Milan), and the stated 'defend by running forward'.

mar.personaBrief: Man-oriented marking across the pitch, centre-backs follow their man (Chiesa di Totti, Wikipedia), though he switches to zonal in the 5-3-2 block (Left Back) and denied the Pogba man-marking.

pla.personaBrief: Same 3-4-x with man-marking and pressing whatever the opponent, built around his model since Genoa; he says he adapts the shape to two strikers but not the idea. Roma are described as adaptable.

res.personaBrief: 'If you want to win, you must attack'; he criticised sterile tic-toc and plays to attack, never closing up. He cares about the result but wins through an attacking, intense identity.

sis.personaBrief: A demanding system with man-marking and high intensity that lifts ordinary and young players (Caldara, Gagliardini), but with a free playmaker in Gomez, whom he ended up clashing with. Everyone has a function.

jog.personaBrief: Loves quick, disciplined, risk-taking players with dribbling and shooting (TFA), with heavy running demands from the press and man-marking. Intensity is non-negotiable.

bas.personaBrief: Preference for developing youth (Left Back, TFA), the Atalanta youth pipeline and sales of Caldara, Kessie, Conti. However he complained that the squad stayed the same too long and asked for a champion.

lid.personaBrief: Authoritarian, demanding coach: Gomez was separated from the squad after a halftime clash and the mutual attack accusations, and he clashed with the owners. Stars follow his rules.
